text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
I completely agree, Tamaki.
Though the rifts between races have been widening lately,
we really should do our best to all work together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わかるわ、タマキさん。
近ごろ種族間の溝は広がる一方だけど、
できれば手を携えていきたいわよね。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Nyow I think about it, you're an elf, right?
With the pointy ears and everything.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういや、
あんたはエルフだにゃ。
耳、尖ってるもんにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
'Cause I heard there's an elf village near here,
and the big explosion caused them a bit of trouble, too.
Maybe you should go check in on them?
text_block_list.orig_text:
この近所にエルフの集落があって、
そっちも爆発の影響でちょっと被害があったみたいだから。
あれなら、
様子を見てくるべきかもにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm...
I really don't have that much of a connection
with the forest elves around here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～……
あたしはこの近所の森のエルフとは、
あんまり関係がないんだけどね。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
They're a separate tribe, you know.
I think the same goes for you, right, Kokkoro?
text_block_list.orig_text:
別の枝族なのよ。
たしか、
コッコロもそうだっけ？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
Though we share a common race,
elves are not united in a single community.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい。
ひとくちにエルフといっても、
一枚岩ではございませんので。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
Still, I do feel some kinship with my fellow elves,
so it concerns me to hear that they may be in trouble.
text_block_list.orig_text:
とはいえ同じ種族ですし、
被害に遭われたというなら安否が気になりますね。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's go pay them a visit later.
In an emergency like this, we all need to help each other.
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、あとで一緒に見に行きましょうか。
非常時だし、
助けあわないとね。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
What's that?
You want to come too, {0}?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？
{0}も、一緒に行きたいの？

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I swear...
When it comes to helping people,
you never hesitate for a second, do you?
choice_data_list: I'm just worried about some people I know.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まったくもう。
あんた、人助けとなると見境がないわね～

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
Oh...?
You even have friends in this village of elves?
How [i]do[/i] you manage it? Elves are usually pretty insular...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅん。
あんた、
エルフの集落にも知りあいがいるのね。
ほんとに顔が広いわよね、
エルフってわりと閉鎖的なのに。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
Actually, hang on a moment.
You just kind of slipped into the conversation, so I forgot to ask,
but where the heck have you two been this whole time, anyway?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってか、あんたたち……
何気なくこの場にいるから、
つい普通に会話しちゃったけど
連絡もせずに行方をくらませて、
これまでどこで何してたわけ？

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
What kind of emotional reunion do you call this?
Shouldn't we be, I don't know, crying or hugging or something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ていうか、
いちおう感動の再会よ？
もっとこう何かあるでしょ、
感極まって抱きあったりさ～？

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! I was only kidding...!
As long as you're safe, it's all good, really...
Just remember, people do worry about you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっ、
冗談よ冗談……
いいわよ、
無事だったならそれで。
あんまり心配させないでよね。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
You're right, I [i]was[/i] worried!
But you don't have to look quite that forlorn about it...
Just fill me on what happened later, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
心配したわよ。
そんな申し訳なさそうな顔しなくてもいいけどね、
あとでちゃんと事情を説明して。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Haha...
Somehow when you're talking to {0},
you seem much more easily flustered, Saren.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ。
サレンさんは{0}くんの前だと、
何だか不器用な感じね。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
And all this after you were worried sick about him.
That's why you were taking out your frustration on me, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
先ほどまですごく心配して苛々していて、
ずいぶん私も八つ当たりされたのに♪

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You think?
H-he's living with us, so he's family...
Worrying about family is normal, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
そう？
ど、
同居人だし……
家族だから、
心配するのは当然でしょっ？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Haha...
Anyway, perhaps it's time
I introduced myself properly to the new faces, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ。
それじゃあ私も、
初対面のかたに対して自己紹介しておきますね。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I'm Mifuyu, from the Mercurius Foundation.
What would my job title be, I wonder? Sales? Admin?
text_block_list.orig_text:
【メルクリウス財団】所属、
ミフユです。
……私の肩書きって何でしょう、
営業？
　事務？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, you're basically like our CEO...
The rest of us are so easygoing,
we don't have much of a work ethic!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミフユは、ほぼ経営者って感じだけどにゃ。
あたしらはテキト～だから、
まともに仕事しないしにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Our guild would fall apart
without you to take charge of stuff!
text_block_list.orig_text:
実際うちのギルドは、
ミフユがいないと成り立たないにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
So, thanks a bunch!
We're always counting on ya!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとにゃ、
いつもお世話になってるにゃ♪

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
If you're aware you barely have a work ethic,
you could try to do something about it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
テキト～だと自覚してるなら、
皆さんも真面目に働いてくださいね。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Heheh.
We've actually got a fair nyumber of guild members,
but most of 'em are back in the city doing regular work.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ。
他にも所属してる人間はわりといるけど、
だいたいは町に残して通常業務をやってもらってるにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: It's just a handful of us that came to help at the farm.
text_block_list.orig_text: 今、牧場にきてるのは数名ってとこにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I know Yukari is busy attending to the injured right now...
But does anyone know where Akino is?
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかしユカリさんは、
負傷者の治療にあたっているはずですが……
アキノさんは、どこに？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
She gets up to the craziest things when you let her
out of your sight, so I'm a little worried...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのひと目を離すと厄介なことをやらかすので、
ちょっと不安なんですけど。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Myahahah!
Last thing I heard, she'd flown off to visit
some of the other farms nearby.
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃはは。
あの子なら、
飛空艇で近隣の牧場に向かったにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
You know,
remember that brother and sister we met
when we saved their farm from corrupt business practices?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら……
あたしらが前に悪徳業者から助けてあげた、
兄妹が経営してる牧場があるにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Well, they and some other nearby farms
are going to be taking care
of Elizabeth Park's animals for a little while.
text_block_list.orig_text:
【牧場（エリザベスパーク）】で育ててた、牛や馬を……
一時的にそういう、
近隣の牧場に預かってもらうことになったにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
It'll be a while before all the fences and stuff here are fixed,
so someone nyeeds to keep an eye on the animals till then.
That's what Akino's sorting out for us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだこの牧場は柵とか設備が復旧しきってないから、
家畜はどっか余所に預ける必要があるからにゃ。
アキノは、
そういう話を通しに行ってるにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I see...
Well, if she's doing legitimate work,
I suppose I can't complain.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ。
やることをやっているなら、
べつに構いませんけどね。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Akino can be a surprisingly convincing negotiator.
I'm sure she'll be able to handle it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アキノさんはなぜか交渉が上手ですしね、
任せても大丈夫でしょう。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Yup, she does have a way of winning people over!
Nyatural charisma, I guess you'd call it?
It's like she was born to be a bigshot!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの子、
天然のひとたらしだからにゃ～
カリスマっていうのかにゃ、
上に立つべく生まれたお嬢さまだからにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
Yes, she's always been that way...
I really don't know how she manages it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ。
昔からそうなのよ、
ずるいのよね～……
あいつは。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
She just does whatever she pleases,
yet things seem to go her way,
and people wind up thanking her in the end.
text_block_list.orig_text:
好き放題に生きてるわりに、
何となく巧くいって、
みんなに感謝されるのよね。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile her friends
struggle just to keep up with her antics!
text_block_list.orig_text:
周りはいつも、
振り回されて大迷惑だけど……♪

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
But I'm relieved to see
she seems to be getting along well
with all of you at the Foundation.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、あいつ……
【メルクリウス財団】のみんなと、
仲良くやれてるみたいで安心したわ。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
Accommodating other people isn't her forte,
so she can be pretty polarizing in the wrong crowd.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あいつ空気が読めないから、
合わない相手とはとことん合わないしさ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Getting along, huh? She's brought me no end of trouble...
Though I guess for all our arguments,
we've managed to make things work as fellow guildmates.
text_block_list.orig_text:
仲良いのかしらね、
喧嘩も絶えないわよ……
それなりに和気藹々と、
同じギルドの仲間として一緒に活動してるけどね。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Hey guys, sorry! Can I get a bit of help over here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのう、
ごめん！　
誰か、こっちを手伝ってくれない？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Whoopsie! We got carried away with the chitchat.
Something up, Yukari?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっと、
つい雑談しちゃってたにゃ……
どうしたにゃ、ユカリ？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
Some monsters have wandered close to the farm,
and it's gotten everyone nervous.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん。
近くを魔物がうろついてるみたいで、
みんなが怖がってるの。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
They haven't done any actual harm just yet,
but so soon after the incident,
people are on edge, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
べつに、暴れたりはしてないみたいなんだけど。
やっぱり被害に遭った直後だから、
みんな不安みたい。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
To be safe,
we're gathering a group of fighters
to drive them out of the area.
text_block_list.orig_text:
念のため。
何人か戦えるひとで集まって、
その魔物を追っ払おうって話になってるの。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
The only thing is,
everyone's exhausted from a hard day's work,
so we're short on fighters.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ただみんな、
朝から肉体労働とかして疲れてるから……
手が足りなくって。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
I'd handle it myself,
but you know I'm more of a healer than a fighter.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私もヒーラーだから、
前線でガツガツ戦うのは苦手だしね。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
So I was hoping for some help
from someone with more combat skills, like Mifuyu.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうのが得意な、
ミフユさんあたりが手伝ってくれると助かるよ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... Mifuyu's overseeing the whole rebuilding effort,
so she can't just abandon her post.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁミフユは全体の統括をしてるから、
この場から動かせないにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Tell you what, I'll help you out!
Where's the nyasties that need beating up?
text_block_list.orig_text:
とりあえず、
あたしが行こうかにゃ。
魔物が出たってのは、どこかにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Right over this way.
And let's hurry!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こっちこっち。
急いでね。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
The girls from Elizabeth Park are holding off the monsters for now...
But most of them barely slept last night,
so I'm worried how they'll hold up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いま【牧場（エリザベスパーク）】のひとたちが、
魔物の相手をしてるけど……
みんな昨日から避難生活をしてて弱ってるから、危ないかも。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Wait a second!
I'll come too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
待ってください。
私も行きます。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Eliminating monsters is one thing I'm good at.
...Saren, can you handle things here for me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
害獣の駆除などは、
得意分野ですので。
……サレンさん、
この場を任せてもいい？

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
All right, no problem.
To be honest, I'd like to help with the monsters too...
text_block_list.orig_text:
了解、
任せて。
あたしも、手伝いたいところだけど……

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
But with all these different guilds doing their own thing,
things could get chaotic quickly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
複数のギルドが各々、
勝手に行動してたらパニックになるしね。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
Someone needs to take charge
and make sure everyone stays on the same page.
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰かが主導して、
全体を管理する必要があるもんね。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
And, well, smoothing things over is a specialty of mine!
So I guess I'll be most useful here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたし、
そういう調停とかは得意だから任せといて。
適材適所よね、
実際。
